item.title: Médiathèque Caroline celebrates teen literature with author events and workshops
item.description: The Monaco library hosts a programme running until late March featuring graphic novel creators, authors and interactive activities for young readers.

item.title: Visit Monaco unveils new brand identity blending Art Nouveau and contemporary design
item.description: Monaco’s tourism authority has unveiled a new visual identity for Visit Monaco, combining Art Nouveau-inspired typography with contemporary design elements in a rebrand aimed at reinforcing the destination’s international appeal. The Direction du Tourisme et des Congrès de Monaco presented the renewed identity last week, describing it as “heritage in motion” and designed to capture both the Principality’s longstanding prestige and its forward-looking character. item.title: Monte-Carlo Opera presents Debussy’s Pelléas et Mélisande
item.description: The Opéra de Monte-Carlo is staging a new production of Claude Debussy's Pelléas et Mélisande, a cornerstone of French lyric repertoire, at the Salle Garnier across four performances from 22nd to 28th February.

item.title: Prince Albert presents medals as Princely Family attends Cortina events
item.description: Prince Albert II and Princess Charlene, accompanied by Hereditary Prince Jacques and Princess Gabriella, attended two events at the XXV Olympic Winter Games Milano Cortina 2026 on Sunday 15th February.

item.title: Football: PSG seize control of Champions League play-off against Monaco
item.description: AS Monaco threw away a two-goal lead against Paris Saint-Germain, who seized the upper-hand in the Champions League play-off at the Stade Louis II on Tuesday night (2-3).

item.title: Faith Kipyegon confirmed for 2026 Herculis EBS Meeting in Monaco
item.description: The Kenyan middle-distance runner will race over 3,000 metres, marking her return to Monaco track competition after taking part in the Monaco Run Gramaglia road race earlier this year.

item.title: UK rejoins Erasmus+ programme from 2027
item.description: French students will once again be able to use the Erasmus+ programme to study, intern or train in the United Kingdom from 1st January 2027.

item.title: What’s behind Monaco’s record-breaking resale boom and property trends in 2025?
item.description: Which districts broke records, which buildings drove the boom — and what does it all mean for Monaco's property market?

item.title: Cyrielle Dailly – the baby sleep whisperer brings American know-how to Monaco
item.description: When Cyrielle Dailly's second son refused to sleep, she did what any exhausted mother would do: desperately searched for answers. What she found was something that would change not only her own life, but the lives of thousands of parents struggling with their baby's sleep.

item.title: Prince’s Palace extends 2026 opening dates for the public
item.description: Monaco's Prince's Palace will reopen to the public on 30th March, offering visitors nearly seven months to explore the State Apartments and their recently restored Renaissance frescoes.
